postView.description: A video post hydrated by an AppView: the author's record plus derived, playable media. 'playlist' and 'thumbnail' point at renditions the AppView's media pipeline produced from the record's video blob; they are not part of the record.

record.description: The social.openreel.video.post record as stored in the author's repository.

playlist.description: HLS multivariant playlist (.m3u8) for the video.

thumbnail.description: Poster image shown before playback starts.

durationMs.description: Duration of the transcoded video in milliseconds, as measured by the media pipeline.

likeCount.description: Number of accounts the AppView has seen like the post (social.openreel.engagement.like records).

commentCount.description: Number of comments (top-level and replies) the AppView has indexed on the post (social.openreel.video.comment records).

labels.description: Moderation labels on the post or its author from the labelers the request asked for (atproto-accept-labelers), plus the author's self-labels. Retracted (neg) and expired labels may be included; clients resolve them.

commentView.description: A comment hydrated by an AppView.

record.description: The social.openreel.video.comment record as stored in the author's repository.

replyCount.description: Replies the AppView has indexed. Only set on top-level comments.

labels.description: Moderation labels on the comment or its author, as on postView.

handle.description: Handle claimed in the author's DID document, if any.
